## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`

Isolated adversarial review of PR objectui#11290 for card objectui#8946, rendered 2026-09-30T23:54Z. Inputs: the card body and its nine comments (claim `5920962399`, os-dev-report `5921708280` and ACCEPT `5921726332` read as claims to test, not as conclusions), the PR body, its 7-file list and the net diff against `main`, and the check-runs on the head, read last. Files at the head were read with `git show`; the spec's source was read at objectstack `0f6dcac5e9` (the 17.5.0 tag commit); the published type graph was read off the registry tarball `@object-ui/app-shell@17.6.0` (published 2026-08-24T14:45Z). Nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`FlowDesignerEdge.condition`: `ExpressionInput` → `EvaluatedExpressionInput` — RIGHT.** At `0f6dcac5e9`, `FlowEdgeSchema.condition` is `EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema.optional()` (`automation/flow.zod.ts`, docblock "An EVALUATED slot (#15807)"), and `EvaluatedExpressionInput` is the `z.input` of that union (`shared/expression.zod.ts`); `ExpressionInputSchema` stays the persistence contract, `source` OR `ast`. The type-level accept set loses exactly one shape: an envelope with no string `source` (the `ast`-only envelope). The bare-string shorthand and a blank `source` are unchanged at the type, because the evaluated `source` is `z.string().refine(NON_BLANK_STRING)`, whose type is `string`; the dev's "no type can refuse a blank `source`" is true. The runtime accept set does not move: every hunk in the three source files touches an `import type`, a type annotation or a comment, and no statement changed.
2. **`SimEdge.condition`, the same swap — RIGHT, and forced.** `flow-sim-edge.types.test.ts` pins `_AgreesWithTheCanvas` as an EQUALITY with the canvas member, and `FlowPreview.tsx` passes its canvas `edges` to `FlowSimulatorPanel`, whose prop is `edges: SimEdge[]`. Leaving `SimEdge` on the persistence type meant weakening that pin or breaking `FlowPreview`. `_PersistedEdgeIsASimEdge` (a server-parsed edge is a `SimEdge`) still holds under the swap: the schema's parsed value is an `EvaluatedExpression`, the union's own envelope arm.
3. **`conditionText` parameter — no accept-set change, RIGHT.** Before: `FlowDesignerEdge['condition']`, which WAS `ExpressionInput | undefined`; after: `ExpressionInput | undefined` written out. Same type, same body, so the reader still takes what a stored artifact can carry, and an `ast`-only envelope still answers `undefined`. The moved docblock sentence is true of the spec: the flow-edge docblock at `0f6dcac5e9` says the bare-string shorthand "still normalizes to `{ dialect: 'cel', source }`" through `EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema`.
4. **`writeExpressionSource` return: `ExpressionInput | undefined` → `EvaluatedExpressionInput | undefined` — RIGHT.** Sound by the body (`if (!source) return undefined`, then the string itself or `{ ...prior, source }` with `ast` deleted: every result carries a string `source`), and covariant for its six callers (`FlowEdgeInspector`, `ActionDefaultInspector`, `HookDefaultInspector`, `PageBlockInspector`, `widgets.tsx`, `ObjectValidationsPanel`), each storing the result in an `ExpressionInput`-typed or wider slot. The new `EvaluatedExpressionEnvelope` alias is module-local, not exported. Not a widening.
5. **Public surface: nothing published moves — RIGHT, verified independently.** `exports` at the head maps only `.` (types `./dist/index.d.ts`) and `./styles.css`. A walk over the published 17.6.0 dist following every relative `from`, bare `import` and `import()` type reference from `dist/index.d.ts` reaches 144 declaration files; `flow-canvas-layout.d.ts`, `expression-envelope.d.ts` and `flow-sim-types.d.ts` are not among them, the positive controls `inspector-registry.d.ts` and `registry.d.ts` are, and no reached file names `FlowDesignerEdge`, `SimEdge`, `writeExpressionSource`, `conditionText` or `EvaluatedExpressionInput`. Adversarial note, so the next reader does not redo it: a SOURCE-level walk from `src/index.ts` at the head DOES reach all three (`index.ts` → side-effect `import './views/metadata-admin/register-builtins.js'` → `previews/index.ts` → `FlowPreview.tsx` → `flow-canvas-layout.ts`; `index.ts` → `ResourceEditPage.tsx` → `widgets.tsx` → `expression-envelope.ts`), which is the reading that would call this "public". Declaration emit prunes those edges: `register-builtins` emits no `.d.ts` at all and `FlowPreview.d.ts` imports only `MetadataPreviewProps`. The dev's count (162 on the head's own build, none of the three) is consistent with 144 on the older published dist. No other workspace package imports the three modules or the two members (git grep over `packages/` and `apps/` at the head). ⇒ Under the published-surface rule these `.d.ts` are shipped bytes, not the published accept set.
6. **Pins — RIGHT and live.** `_IsExactlyTheSpecType` now names the evaluated type; `_IsNotThePersistenceType` carries its own `_PersistenceNotAny` guard; `_AstOnlyRejected` has `_AstOnlyIsPersistable` as the lit control in both pin files; the canvas pin file adds an inline `@ts-expect-error` on an object literal; the simulator fixture keeps feeding an `ast`-only guard at run time under `@ts-expect-error`, so the run-time refusal in `flow-sim-validate.ts` stays exercised. `tsconfig.test.json` includes `src/**/*.test.ts` and is chained from `type-check`; the head's `Type Check` check-run is success. The `spec-symbol-parity.test.ts` row is a string triple (`'FlowDesignerEdge', 'FlowEdge', …`) that compiles against nothing; leaving it is correct.
7. **Docblocks — RIGHT.** The `FlowDesignerEdge` docblock names both contracts and which one the member mirrors; the module header now says the guard reader reads the persisted contract; the `conditionText` sentence the card flagged moved with the parameter. No model identifier and no cross-file `path:line` in the diff, the changeset or the PR body (Line Citation Gate success).

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/8946-flow-edge-evaluated-condition.md` declares `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`. What the diff publishes: JS identical apart from comments (item 1), plus `.d.ts` changes in three modules the entry's type graph cannot reach and `exports` cannot address (item 5). AGENTS.md requires a changeset for any `src/` edit in the fixed group and allows an empty one for internal-only change; `patch` is the minimal non-empty level and a CHANGELOG paragraph is the right place for the next reader of this slot, so **`patch` MATCHES**. `minor` would price as public a type that is not; the 17.2.0 CHANGELOG precedent ("Type change (minor, public)") for this same member predates the published-surface rule and yields to it: no flip. Every claim in the changeset prose checked true against the spec source and the head: the two contracts, objectstack#15807, the `^17.5.0` dependency, `conditionText` still answering `undefined` for `ast`-only, `writeExpressionSource` always carrying a string `source`, reachability, JS identical apart from comments. `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`, `Changeset Claim Re-read` and `Changeset Overwrite Report` are all success on the head.

**`Clause-②: no` — RIGHT.** The added lines carry none of the four widening tells: no schema key, no union or enum member, no export row, no registration. The diff narrows two type members and one return type and widens nothing; the claim's justification ("two envelopes the server already refuses at parse stop type-checking; nothing is widened") holds.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev flags (os-dev-report `5921708280`, `deviations`), each answered:
1. Blank-`source` pin dropped — ANSWERED, correct: a `.refine` on a string narrows no type, so the directive would be an unused-directive error (TS2578). Documented in the docblock and the pin header instead; accepted.
2. Pins in the two flow-edge `.types.test.ts` files, not the parity table — ANSWERED, correct: `tsconfig.test.json` compiles both and the parity row is a name table; accepted.
3. `patch` not `minor` — ANSWERED in ②: `patch` stands, no flip.
4. File surface beyond the claim (`flow-sim-types.ts`, `expression-envelope.ts`, `flow-simulator.test.ts`) — ANSWERED: forced by `_AgreesWithTheCanvas` and `FlowSimulatorPanel.edges: SimEdge[]` (item 2) and by tsc-measured consumers; the amendment is recorded on the card in ACCEPT `5921726332`; accepted.
5. `FlowEdgeInspector.tsx` needed no edit — ANSWERED: its one write is `patchEdge({ condition: writeExpressionSource(edge.condition, v) })`, which now returns the evaluated type, and `previous: unknown` takes the narrowed member; accepted.
6. Worktree removed, probe refs deleted — hygiene, no contract content.

`open_questions`: none declared, none found.

Out-of-scope finding (`ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx` types `condition` / `when` as `ExpressionInput` and its docblock says the validation `condition` is `ExpressionInputSchema`; `PageBlockInspector.visibleWhen` has the same shape, not measured) — the seat's disposition was "Acceptance notes, not filed". **ESCALATED to the dispatching seat: file it.** The premise is corroborated at `0f6dcac5e9`: the `EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema` docblock says that since #15811 it is the schema of EVERY evaluated slot, naming validation `condition` / `when`, the field / form / section / component `visibleWhen` predicates, hook `condition`, action `visible` / `disabled` and more. So the panel's docblock is a false contract claim today, and every app-shell mirror of an evaluated slot that still imports `ExpressionInput` is this card's defect class, one slot over. It is outside this PR's file surface and does not touch this verdict; but "noted, not filed" leaves a measured false docblock with no board entry, which is the road objectui#3171 was filed on. One follow-up card, censused by the `ExpressionInput` imports under `packages/app-shell/src`, is the ask.

Success includes `Type Check`, `Lint`, `Build & E2E`, `Test (dist pins)`, `Test (shard 3/8, 6/8, 7/8)`, `Line Citation Gate`, `Control Byte Scan`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Spec Main Shape Gate` and the five changeset gates.
